ordered_diagnoses: Myxoid leiomyoma of the ciliary body

s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive vision decline with a posterior segment mass
salient_findings: Declining vision in the left eye
Nasal mass posterior to the lens in the left eye
Large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
key_facts: 20-year-old woman
Monitored for a left ciliary body mass for 3 years
Best-corrected visual acuity 20/20 OD and 20/50 OS
Pupils, intraocular pressures, anterior chambers, and lenses unremarkable in both eyes
Nasal mass posterior to the lens in the left eye has grown in size
Ophthalmoscopic examination shows a large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
Ultrasound biomicroscopy shows a round, cystoid mass with a stalk attached to the nasal pars plana
Vitreous aspirate cytology negative for malignant cells
Microscopic findings show a hypovascular myxoid lesion composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells
Immunohistochemical studies show positive S100 and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein

shortlist: Myxoid leiomyoma of the ciliary body

shortlist.label: Medulloepithelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Posterior segment mass with growth and vision decline

shortlist.label: Intraocular myxoma
shortlist.why_kept: Hypovascular myxoid lesion with positive S100 and glial fibrillary acidic protein

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Positive S100 and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein

shortlist.label: Myxoid leiomyoma of the ciliary body
shortlist.why_kept: Hypovascular myxoid lesion with spindle and stellate cells

shortlist.label: Plexiform schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Positive S100 and spindle cell morphology

raw.rationale: The case facts, including the hypovascular myxoid lesion composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells, positive S100, and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein, are most consistent with an intraocular myxoma, which is a rare, benign tumor.

rejected.label: Medulloepithelioma
rejected.why: Typically presents with malignant cells and more aggressive behavior, not seen in this case

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Usually shows stronger and more uniform S100 positivity and a more cellular morphology

rejected.label: Myxoid leiomyoma of the ciliary body
rejected.why: Would be expected to show positive smooth muscle actin, which was negative in this case

rejected.label: Plexiform schwannoma
rejected.why: Typically shows a more complex, plexiform growth pattern and stronger S100 positivity
